            +params[6]*np.cos(params[7]*t)+params[8]*np.sin(params[7]*t)+params[9]*t)

    return 1-np.sum((dv_dt-A@c)**2)/np.sum((dv_dt-dv_dt.mean())**2), c

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    g = t**params[7]
    return (params[0]+params[1]*x+params[2]*x**2+params[3]*x**3+params[4]*v+params[5]*x*v
            +g*(params[6]+params[8]*x+params[9]*x**2))
